name: Y'all Means All Rainbow Whipped Body Butter
blurb: Whipped light and fluffy in a citrus-peach blend, with rainbow swirls that mean all of it: every color, every one of us. Melts in without the grease and keeps skin soft all day. Everybody's welcome, moisturized.

usageGuide.howToApply: Smooth a dollop over clean, towel-dry skin from neck to toes. Absorbs quickly without greasy residue.
usageGuide.storage: Keep in a cool, dark place away from heat vents or direct sun. Shelf life is 6–12 months.
usageGuide.patchTest: Test a pea-sized amount on inner forearm 24 hours before full use.
